newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares gain in more active trade. [CORRECTED 18:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares gain in more active trade. [CORRECTED 18:00 GMT]

text.p: Lithuanian shares gained slightly and the market picked up steam on Thursday as investors came off the sidelines, dealers said.
Overall central market activity was over three million litas and the Litin A index edged up almost 20 points to 2,580.14.
The Litin G index also gained, rising by 22.63 points to 2,273.57.
Block trades reached over 6.6 million litas.
"Investors are coming back now that the big shareholders' meetings are over and they've had time to examine the results," said Tomas Adrejauskas of brokerage firm Suprema.
"Investors are also expecting good first quarter results from many companies," he added.
Big gainers included Vilniaus Bank, which regained much of the ground it lost recently, rising almost ten percent to 250.40 litas in trade of over 500,000 litas.
Rokishkis Cheese rose 2.2 percent to 46.00 litas in trade of over 172,000 litas.
But some blue chips lost ground as short-term investors tried to unload their shares with dividends in hand, dealers said.
Hermis Bank eased to 190.00 litas from 198.00 litas but its shares turned over almost 810,000 litas.
Birzai Dairy rose to 9.50 litas from 8.73 litas in trade of just over 26,000 litas.
